title: PlanGetReply
description: The parsed form of a plan_get reply (a plan and why members were left out): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

segments.description: The plan's segments, each its instances in order.

items.description: One item: instance numbers, in order.
One item: a whole number, not negative.

reasons.description: The members left out, each with its reason.

items.title: Reason
items.description: A member and the reason it was left out of a plan.

cores.description: Each segment's cores, member by member, - for a worker pinned to none.

items.description: One item: each member's core, in the segment's order.
One item: an audio core, or - for a worker pinned to none.
